name: apex
description: Apex — private single-user personal dashboard (PWA + Node API).

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @apex/api" "npm run dev -w @apex/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @apex/api && npm run build -w @apex/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @apex/api && npm run typecheck -w @apex/web
